_note: Config of mango-voice.py. Copy this file to mango-voice.json and edit the values. model: faster-whisper model name (tiny/base/small/medium/large-v3). language: ISO-639-1 language code passed to Whisper. device: input microphone (index as in --devices, or name). null = system default. compute_type: CPU quantization (int8 recommended on CPU without GPU). tap_hold_ms: tap/hold threshold of the space bar in milliseconds. poll_ms: how often, in ms, the worker transcribes the accumulated window. finalize_lag_ms: a segment is typed only if followed by this much silence. min_audio_ms: minimum amount of audio to transcribe. max_window_s: beyond this duration the window is forced to close.
